WHAT COMPLETION COST COVERS (TEC-10)
Completion of the new directional drilling well in the El Abra Formation. The completion operation will consist of:
(1) Install the head and pressure test at 35 Mpa
(2) Assemble the drilling equipment service and connect pipe with the drill and scraper in work sequence. Clean PBTD well inside a 4.5-inch liner. Remove from the well.
(3) Connect the casing in the logs of the hole drilling cable to perform the cement bond register and the integrating register of the cladding through 4.5in and 7in cladding cords
(4) Drilling guns to connect pipe and perforated areas through the El Abra formation (up to 20 m of drilling through 4 intervals)
(5) Acidification tools to connect tubing in 73 mm tubes perform separate well stimulations with cement and acidizing pump.
(6) Clean the well again to the exhausted acid recovery testers and the termination fluid.
(7) Well removal test tools and connect 73mm pipeline pipe chain and hole bottom assembly with recoverable hole bottom gauges
(8) Install a 35 Mpa wellhead
(9) Perform 10-day cleaning / flow test to third-party testers
(10) Closure of well at the end of the test and record the accumulation of pressure and temperature of formation
(11) Retrieve downhole and header meters
